snippet.title: Quest Master's 1st MAJOR UPDATE! | Out Now! | Steam Early Access
snippet.description:
Experience this Zelda-Like Maker now! ► http://apo.gg/QuestMaster
The brand-new Quest Master theme, Gustwind Palace and many new items, gizmos, and mechanics! This is our biggest update since Early Access launched two months ago.
What’s New:
 • Gustwind Palace Theme: Soar high with parallax sky backgrounds and lush greenery.
 • Turbines: Four types that suck or blow objects, affecting even airborne items.
 • Gusts of Wind: New projectile to move objects until it hits a wall.
 • Whirlwinds: Shoot objects skyward to higher elevations.
 • Tornado Rod: Creates powerful temporary tornados.
 • Hermes Boots: Run at super-speed, compatible with various momentum-based objects.
 • Slides: Run up with Hermes Boots or slide down with other objects.
 • Mud Tiles: Crossable only with Hermes Boots.
 • Balloon Modifier: Makes objects fly, but they fall if the balloon is popped.
 • Ladders: Climb to different floors.
 • Decorations: New windows, bushes, and skulls for all themes.
 • Number Signs: From 1-8 for sequence puzzles.

Sale: Get 20% off for two weeks!

Enjoy and stay tuned for more exciting updates!DISCORD: ► https://discord.gg/apogee
